answer_1.quote: We design a reference-based automatic evaluation metric (CMN), which can robustly evaluate open-domain dialogues with a single gold-standard reference. ... open-domain dialogue generation ...
answer_1.outputs: Automatic evaluation scores for generated dialogue responses

answer_2.quote: We compare our model with the baselines in terms of how well the evaluation scores generated by the model correlate with human judgments. ... we use BLEU, ROUGE, METEOR, Embedding-Average, Vector-Extrema, Greedy-Matching, BERTScore, BLEURT, RUBER, MAUDE, MDD-Eval, and our CMN metric.

answer_4.quote: We recruited three human annotators to evaluate the evaluation set ... annotators were asked to rate two aspects: Appropriateness, which measures the degree to which the output is appropriate within the given context, and Coherence, which assesses the extent to which the content of the output is presented in a well-structured, logical, and meaningful manner. These ratings were provided on a 1-5 Likert scale.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators rated each response on Appropriateness and Coherence using a 1-5 Likert scale.
